verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is the PowerPoint claim that users can "describe visuals, and generate," which implies prompt-driven visual creation inside presentations. The pack never documents standalone image generation or prompt-based image editing. Vision covers analyzing images, not creating them, and code-generated graphs are charts rather than images. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of text-to-image generation, natural-language image editing or refinement, details on supported image formats or models, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
